title: Archived LLM API price changes, 2024-2026
description: Price changes on official provider pricing pages, reconstructed from Internet Archive Wayback Machine snapshots and provider announcements. Each record links the last archived page that shows the old price and the first that shows the new price. Third-party price lists were used only to find candidates; every record is backed by official pages.
unit_note: All prices are USD per 1M tokens.
